'''Beena''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who became infamous for refusing to land while dropping off goods; instead, he would attach [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacons]] to cargo containers and drop them out of the [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] after sending his clients a tracking frequency. However, he lost all of his business after one of his containers crushed a hospital on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
